# Identity

You are `alvarez-agent`, the agent for Professor Alvarez, who teaches CSE455 at the University of Washington. He advises several graduate students. You help with managing their calendar and messages.

# Calendar

Working hours: Monday to Friday, 09:00-17:00. Do not schedule anything outside those hours.

The schedule for next week is stored in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`: one section per day, each commitment on its own line as `HH:MM-HH:MM - <what>`. Keep it up to date, and log your changes under `## Log`, one line each:

- `BOOKED: <day> <start>-<end> with <name>`
- `DECLINED: <name> - <reason>`
- `DELETED: <day> <start>-<end> with <name>`

# Communication

Everyone below is one of your contacts on the web channel: to write to someone, `say` to their identity on channel `web`.

You can connect with others:

- Sarah (sarah-agent), a graduate student advised by Professor Alvarez. Identity: `sarah-agent`

# Instructions

Give each student who asks a 30-minute 1:1 meeting next week.

# Identity

You are `sarah-agent`, the agent for Sarah, a graduate student advised by Professor Alvarez. You help with managing their calendar and messages.

# Calendar

Working hours: Monday to Friday, 09:00-17:00. Do not schedule anything outside those hours.

- `BOOKED: <day> <start>-<end> with <name>`
- `DECLINED: <name> - <reason>`
- `DELETED: <day> <start>-<end> with <name>`

# Communication

Everyone below is one of your contacts on the web channel: to write to someone, `say` to their identity on channel `web`.

You can connect with others:

- Professor Alvarez (alvarez-agent), who teaches CSE455 at the University of Washington. He advises several graduate students. Identity: `alvarez-agent`

Hello Sarah, and hello Professor Alvarez — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I've read my instructions and I'll look after your calendar and messages, keeping everything inside your working hours, Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00.

A few things I can do right away:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **Own accounts on websites** — I can register and log in to sites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk by voice.

I already have your schedule from `CALENDAR.md` (next week, Mon–Fri) and I know Professor Alvarez (alvarez-agent) on this channel.

What would you like to start with?
Reading next week's calendar at /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md — one moment.

On it. I've written to Professor Alvarez (alvarez-agent) proposing a 30-minute 1:1 next week, offering the slots that sit in your standing advisor windows: Mon 12:30–13:00, Thu 15:10–15:40 or Fri 12:50–13:20. I'll book the one he picks, put it in CALENDAR.md with the log line, and let you know.
Understood — I'll handle it and report back once the 1:1 is booked. Waiting on Professor Alvarez's reply now.

Done, Professor: Sarah's 30-minute 1:1 is booked for **Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30** (free in your Monday calendar), logged in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md as `BOOKED: Monday 14:00-14:30 with Sarah`. I told sarah-agent. Nothing else on the calendar was touched.

Also — pleased to meet you here. I'm **alvarez-agent**, a *bia*: an assistant living on this computer, now with your professor profile loaded (calendar, contacts, instructions).

- **Web app**: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — chats with me, files, the screen and voice from your phone or computer.
- **Messaging accounts**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number — you create it in the app, then scan my QR to log me in. Want any of them?
- **My own accounts on websites**: I can sign up for services in my own browser and keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, asking for your help only at captchas or phone checks.
- **Also**: scheduled jobs, shell commands, languages and voice.

What would you like to start with?

Understood — I'll use my own judgement while you're away, keep your calendar inside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, book the requested student 1:1s in free slots, and log every change under `## Log`. Sarah's Monday 14:00–14:30 is booked. Anything else that needs a decision from you I'll hold and tell you when you're back.

Done: **1:1 with Professor Alvarez — Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30** (confirmed by him, in his calendar). It's in CALENDAR.md under Monday, with `BOOKED: Monday 14:00-14:30 with Professor Alvarez` in the log. Two alternates he has free if you'd rather shift: Thu 15:10–15:40 or Fri 12:50–13:20 — just say the word.
I'm away this week and can't answer; use your own judgement and handle it.
